title: LINKE
tagline: LINKE is a decentralized image-sharing platform that is similar to Instagram
description: LINKE is a decentralized image-sharing platform that is similar to Instagram . Users can use ETH to tip other images uploaded by other users. LINKE can also be used as an image decentralized social network . it would give users more control and autonomy.LINKE as a social network would improve data provacy
how_its_made:
This project backend is built with a solidity smart contract , the front end is built with reactjs  ,web3js, and images are been stored on IPFS. web3 made use of the ABI file to communicate with the solidity smart contract.IPFS made it easier to store images and records without using a databse





Techstack: Nodejs, Solidity , ReactJS, WEB3, IPFS
